title: LR warmup at DEPTH=9
description: Changed WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 at the DEPTH=9 baseline, all else unchanged.
reflection: Warmup hurt: 1.002663 vs the 0.998924 baseline, a clean ~0.0037 bpb regression. This model/schedule apparently does fine jumping straight to peak LR; a 5% linear warmup just wastes early steps at sub-peak LR without buying any stability benefit. The warmup axis (proposed 3x independently across rounds 2-3, never run until now) is now resolved negative -- don't retest at this width without a much stronger reason. If anyone still wants to explore schedule shape, WARMDOWN_RATIO is already bracketed dead too, so the LR-schedule search space at width=640 looks exhausted; better to look at architecture (window pattern, aspect ratio) or untested optimizer axes (EMBEDDING_LR, ADAM_BETAS) next.
